capabilities: extract atomic notes from an article using an LLM
add links and tags to generated notes
create a Map of Content that embeds and groups related notes
configure note count, tags, language and extra properties
extras: Extraction of long articles can take about 30 seconds or longer. Roadmap lists unfinished items such as local LLM support.
problem: Turning a long article into a set of small, linked notes and organizing them under a Map of Content is slow to do by hand.

relations.evidence: Special credits to Liam's Periodic Notes Plugin and HyeonseoNam's Auto Classifier. Portions of their code were instrumental
Special credits to Liam's Periodic Notes Plugin and HyeonseoNam's Auto Classifier. Portions of their code were instrumental

summary: LLM-powered plugin that breaks long articles into linked atomic notes and generates Maps of Content from note titles.
